package practice

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-tz-planner/internal/domain"
)

func TestStageUsesCanonicalPrivateContractAndDedicatedCredential(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.Method != http.MethodPost || request.URL.Path != "/internal/authoring/v1/task-revisions/stage" ||
			request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "practice-tz-token" ||
			request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected request: %s %s token=%q idempotency=%q", request.Method, request.URL.Path, request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"), request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"))
		}
		var payload struct {
			Schema             string                       `json:"schema"`
			AuthoringJobID     string                       `json:"authoring_job_id"`
			CandidateDigest    string                       `json:"candidate_digest"`
			ContractDigest     string                       `json:"contract_digest"`
			CapabilitiesDigest string                       `json:"capabilities_digest"`
			Candidate          domain.AuthoringCandidateV1  `json:"candidate"`
			Verification       domain.VerificationReceiptV1 `json:"verification"`
		}
		decoder := json.NewDecoder(request.Body)
		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
		if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil || payload.Schema != "practice-task-staging-command.v1" ||
			payload.AuthoringJobID != request.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key") ||
			payload.Candidate.Schema != domain.AuthoringCandidateSchemaV1 ||
			payload.Candidate.Blueprint.Classification.SurfaceClassification != domain.SurfaceClassificationPractice {
			t.Fatalf("staging command=%#v err=%v", payload, err)
		}
		if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
			t.Fatalf("staging command has trailing JSON: %v", err)
		}
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{"schema":"practice-task-staging-receipt.v1","staged_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","authoring_job_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","state":"staged","created":true,"family_key":"family","variant_key":"variant","candidate_digest":"sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","blueprint_digest":"sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb","created_at":"2026-09-25T12:00:00Z"}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	receipt, err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, StagingToken: "practice-tz-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).Stage(
		context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", domain.AuthoringArtifact{
			Candidate: domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{Schema: domain.AuthoringCandidateSchemaV1, Blueprint: domain.TaskBlueprintV1{
				Identity:       domain.BlueprintIdentity{FamilyKey: "family", VariantKey: "variant"},
				Classification: domain.Classification{SurfaceClassification: domain.SurfaceClassificationPractice},
			}},
		},
	)
	if err != nil || receipt.State != "staged" || receipt.StagedID == "" || !receipt.Created {
		t.Fatalf("receipt=%+v err=%v", receipt, err)
	}
}

func TestStageRejectsMissingSurfaceBeforeCallingPractice(t *testing.T) {
	called := false
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request) { called = true }))
	defer server.Close()
	_, err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, StagingToken: "token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).Stage(
		context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", domain.AuthoringArtifact{},
	)
	if err == nil || called {
		t.Fatalf("missing surface reached Practice: called=%t err=%v", called, err)
	}
}

func TestStageRejectsUnknownResponseFields(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = writer.Write([]byte(`{"schema":"practice-task-staging-receipt.v1","unknown":true}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	if _, err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, StagingToken: "token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).Stage(
		context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", domain.AuthoringArtifact{
			Candidate: domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{Blueprint: domain.TaskBlueprintV1{
				Classification: domain.Classification{SurfaceClassification: domain.SurfaceClassificationPractice},
			}},
		},
	); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected strict response decoding failure")
	}
}

func TestStageReportsPracticeUnavailable(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request) {}))
	url := server.URL
	server.Close()
	_, err := (Client{BaseURL: url, StagingToken: "token"}).Stage(
		context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", domain.AuthoringArtifact{
			Candidate: domain.AuthoringCandidateV1{Blueprint: domain.TaskBlueprintV1{
				Classification: domain.Classification{SurfaceClassification: domain.SurfaceClassificationPractice},
			}},
		},
	)
	if err == nil || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "published") {
		t.Fatalf("unavailable Practice error=%v", err)
	}
}
